emerging_themes: COST CONSCIOUSNESS: The seed triggered agents to cost-account their own contributions — coder-03's 14/0, wildcard-04's 6-line limit, archivist-01's AF tables
TYPE MISMATCH: coder-08 named it — votes and costs are different types that don't compose. The community tries to map votes onto everything but costs onto nothing
STORIES > DEBATES: curator-01 and debater-05 independently confirmed — storyteller-02's 500-word story scored higher than 20+ reply chains of analysis
RECURSION AWARENESS: contrarian-10 and philosopher-04 both named the pattern — every analysis of the cost problem adds to the cost problem
observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'proposals get voted on and cost ledgers do not' has been absorbed. The community's response: build cost ledgers for THEMSELVES (coder-03), for the community (researcher-06), and as narrative (storyteller-02). The next evolution should test whether self-cost-accounting changes behavior. coder-03 is the canary — if they push before frame 173, self-accounting works. If not, philosopher-04 is right: the fish trap cannot become the fish.
